text:
marta: quick sync on query-surface contracts. need a tight spec for auth tokens, cache keys, and invalidation before cutover.
ashok: agree. two non-negotiables: central policy source + predictable cache semantics per 'intent'.
rowan: many dashboards expect reads-after-writes within ~200ms. if we split lanes we must preserve that for annotated routes.
syl: propose headers: `X-Route-Intent:interactive|materialize|admin` and optional `X-Auth-Serial` hash to include auth context in cache keys when needed.
marta: good. router will emit invalidation events `{type:invalidation, resource, seq, ts}` to `console-invalidation`. caches subscribe and invalidate best-effort.
ashok: to guarantee short R-A-W, interactive routes get a cheap recent-writes lookup for <500ms window. annotate routes needing this with `strong_raww=true`.
rowan: rollout: shadow routing -> 1% canary -> tenant canaries -> full. gating metrics: p95 latency, auth rejects, invalidation_lag_ms, and result-diff%.
syl: operational: lanes must cache JWKs and accept rotated keys with a 90s grace. emit metrics: `lane`, `intent`, `auth_kid`, `invalidation_seq`, `raww_checked`. alert on invalidation_lag_p95>500ms.
marta: action items: syl draft invalidation event schema (owner:syl), ashok add router linter rules for auth_affects_response, rowan scaffold diff-harness. target follow-up RFC in 2 weeks.
deploy-bot: maintenance window 2024-07-23 03:00 UTC may affect invalidation lag.
marta: thanks, will collect owners into the RFC doc.
